title: ARI driver data
description: Driver metadata, CLI launch manifests and instance creation input. The `Driver` interface itself is hand-written TypeScript.

CliLaunchArgs.description: Arguments for each launch kind. `{sessionId}` and `{cwd}` are placeholders the host fills in.

CliMcpInjection.description: How a host passes MCP servers to the CLI. `inline_json`: `flag` followed by a JSON config string. `config_file`: `flag` followed by the path of a JSON file the host writes. `env`: the JSON config string in the environment variable `env`.

CliLaunchManifest.description: A declarative launch descriptor for hosts that offer a native terminal fallback.

envScrubPrefixes.description: Environment variables whose names start with one of these prefixes are removed before launch.

config.description: The instance's own config, valid against the driver's `configSchema`.

environment.description: Environment variables the host chose for this instance.

DriverDescriptor.description: The driver's non-method members, as the wire handshake carries them.
